title: follow platform ok cancel order
rule: Follow the platform convention for OK/Cancel order (Windows: OK first; Apple: OK last; web: the platform of most users).
pass_when: Commit/dismiss order matches the platform (Windows OK first; Apple OK last; web = platform of most users).
fail_when: A third invented sequence, or the opposite of the target platform.
overview: Commit and dismiss buttons follow the host platform’s OK/Cancel order.
apply_when: Laying out OK/Cancel or commit/dismiss pairs on dialogs.
not_when: Single-action views with no paired dismiss control to order.
agent_hint: Match platform order: Windows OK first, Apple OK last, web majority.
description: Commit and dismiss order is muscle memory. Follow the platform: Windows puts OK before Cancel; Apple puts OK last; on the web, match the platform most users are on. Inventing a third sequence or flipping the target platform’s order creates slips. Use this for paired commit/dismiss controls, not for lone primary actions with no cancel sibling.
